message: Gutter Duel is ready as a 14-component printable proposal: redirect a shared stream, block your rival’s routes, and score water reaching your rooftop. The green garden includes an editable 3D roof landmark. Apply the proposal to add it to the workspace.

brief.intent: Spatial outmaneuvering between rival rooftop gardeners sharing scarce rainwater; printable.
brief.coreLoop: Rotate one unlocked gutter a quarter-turn, trace one drop from the center, and score whichever garden receives it.

critique.issue: Design hypothesis: the opening player may benefit from the first available scoring route.
critique.check: Play two games with the same layout, swapping starting players. Compare scores and opening choices; balance is not yet verified.

critique.issue: Design hypothesis: the lock prevents immediate reversals, but repeated defensive loops may still suppress scoring.
critique.check: Count wasted drops during the first game. If more than six of twelve are wasted, test allowing a half-turn as an additional rotation choice.

critique.issue: Design hypothesis: tracing routes could exceed the ten-minute target.
critique.check: Time twelve turns. Stop tracing immediately on a repeated tile; every route requires checking at most nine tiles.
